senses.gloss: कुट् KUṬ, divide, break up.
कुट्ट् KUṬṬ, Ⅹ. P. kuṭṭaya, crush, bruise. 🞄vi, lacerate.
कुटज kuṭa-ja, m. a tree (Wrightia antidysenterica).
कुटरु kuṭáru, m. cock.

कुटि kuṭ-i, f. bend, curve (—˚);
 hut, shed.
कुटी kuṭī, f. = kuṭi.
कुटिलाशय kuṭila‿āśaya, a. having crooked 🞄aims.
कुटिलिका kuṭil-ikā, f. winding movement 🞄(on the stage).
कुटिलीकृ kuṭilī-kṛ, knit (the brows).
कुट्ट kuṭṭa, ˚क -ka, a. crushing or grinding 🞄with (—˚).

कुट्टन kuṭṭ-ana, n. stamping;
 ī, f. procuress.

कुट्टार kuṭṭ-āra, a. tearing, lacerating (—˚);
 🞄m. brawler.

कुट्टिनी kuṭṭ-inī, f. procuress;
 -kapaṭa, m. 🞄N. of a rogue.
कुट्टिम kuṭṭ-ima, n. levelled floor.
कूटयुद्ध kūṭa-yuddha, read n. for m..
